title: What I self-host
summary: A personal blog post where the author shares their self-hosted infrastructure setup, detailing the various services and applications they run on their own servers including media servers, productivity tools, and development environments.
problem_solved: Provides practical examples and inspiration for building personal self-hosted infrastructure instead of relying on third-party cloud services.
why_valuable: Demonstrates real-world self-hosting implementations that promote digital sovereignty, privacy, and cost savings while helping others learn what services can be self-hosted.
